title: Detailed snowman
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='snow' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#dceefc'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#a8cfe8'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='snow2' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#e2f1fb'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b3d6ec'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- bottom body ball -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='30' ry='19' fill='url(#snow)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='30' ry='19' fill='none' stroke='#9fc6e0' stroke-width='1.2'/>

  <!-- middle ball -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='21' fill='url(#snow2)'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='21' fill='none' stroke='#9fc6e0' stroke-width='1.2'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='15' fill='url(#snow2)'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='15' fill='none' stroke='#9fc6e0' stroke-width='1.2'/>

  <!-- shadow shading bottom ball -->
  <path d='M26 88 Q50 96 74 88' fill='none' stroke='#bfe0f2' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- scarf around neck -->
  <path d='M36 43 Q50 49 64 43 L64 47 Q50 53 36 47 Z' fill='#e8453c'/>
  <path d='M36 43 Q50 49 64 43 L64 47 Q50 53 36 47 Z' fill='none' stroke='#b52b24' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <path d='M60 46 L64 62 L57 60 L55 47 Z' fill='#e8453c'/>
  <path d='M60 46 L64 62 L57 60 L55 47 Z' fill='none' stroke='#b52b24' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <path d='M58 50 L61 50 M58 54 L62 54 M59 58 L63 58' stroke='#ffd24a' stroke-width='1.3' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='27' r='2.4' fill='#2b2b3a'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='27' r='2.4' fill='#2b2b3a'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='26.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='26.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- carrot nose -->
  <polygon points='50,31 50,36 62,34.5' fill='#ff9b2f'/>
  <polygon points='50,31 50,36 62,34.5' fill='none' stroke='#d9741a' stroke-width='0.7'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='33' x2='54' y2='35.4' stroke='#d9741a' stroke-width='0.7'/>
  <line x1='58' y1='33.4' x2='58' y2='35.2' stroke='#d9741a' stroke-width='0.7'/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M43 37 Q50 42 57 37' fill='none' stroke='#2b2b3a' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='45.5' cy='38.6' r='0.8' fill='#2b2b3a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='39.6' r='0.8' fill='#2b2b3a'/>
  <circle cx='54.5' cy='38.6' r='0.8' fill='#2b2b3a'/>

  <!-- cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='32' rx='2.6' ry='1.6' fill='#ffb8b8' opacity='0.85'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='32' rx='2.6' ry='1.6' fill='#ffb8b8' opacity='0.85'/>

  <!-- hat -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='17.5' rx='16' ry='3.2' fill='#2c3e8f'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='17.5' rx='16' ry='3.2' fill='none' stroke='#1a2a6b' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <path d='M38 17 L39.5 4 Q50 1 60.5 4 L62 17 Z' fill='#3049ad'/>
  <path d='M38 17 L39.5 4 Q50 1 60.5 4 L62 17 Z' fill='none' stroke='#1a2a6b' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <path d='M38.5 12 L61.5 12' stroke='#e8453c' stroke-width='2.4'/>
  <path d='M38.5 12 L61.5 12' stroke='#b52b24' stroke-width='0.6' transform='translate(0,0)' opacity='0'/>

  <!-- hat pom -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='3' r='3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='3' r='3' fill='none' stroke='#cfe6f5' stroke-width='0.7'/>

  <!-- buttons -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='1.9' fill='#2b2b3a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='1.9' fill='#2b2b3a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='68' r='1.9' fill='#2b2b3a'/>

  <!-- stick arms -->
  <g stroke='#8a5a2b' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'>
    <path d='M31 54 L16 44'/>
    <path d='M18 46 L14 38'/>
    <path d='M18 46 L12 48'/>
    <path d='M69 54 L84 44'/>
    <path d='M82 46 L86 38'/>
    <path d='M82 46 L88 48'/>
  </g>

  <!-- snowflakes around -->
  <g stroke='#dff1fc' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <path d='M14 70 L14 76 M11 73 L17 73 M12.5 71.5 L15.5 74.5 M15.5 71.5 L12.5 74.5'/>
    <path d='M86 68 L86 74 M83 71 L89 71 M84.5 69.5 L87.5 72.5 M87.5 69.5 L84.5 72.5'/>
    <path d='M22 22 L22 27 M19.5 24.5 L24.5 24.5'/>
    <path d='M80 26 L80 31 M77.5 28.5 L82.5 28.5'/>
  </g>
</svg>
